messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call exec recap: Redwood Inference + NovaCorp — exec summary & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Framing this as an exec-friendly recap so we can align on risk, outcomes, and the procurement path. Please flag any corrections.

TL;DR
- Pain points: production latency and inference cost at 1M+ monthly requests; sensitive customer PII in prompts requiring stronger isolation/data residency; inconsistent SLA across current provider.
- Goals: reduce per-token cost by ~40% (target $0.002/token), get predictable 99.95% inference availability for peak hours, and ensure SOC2+KMS-managed keys for PII.
- Business outcomes: 1) reduce inference cost to free up budget for product expansion; 2) enable faster search/query features with <200ms median response for 95% of requests; 3) meet security requirements for upcoming gov pilot.

Key risks / escalation items
- Data residency & key management: NovaCorp requires KMS integration and strict logging — security needs SOC2 evidence + network diagram (Priya noted).
- SLA guarantees: requirement for 99.95% availability across peak window — this may need a dedicated capacity commitment (redwood dedicated).
- Integration effort: on-prem connectors for anonymization may add ~3-4 weeks to integration scope.

Procurement path & timeline (as discussed)
- Security & procurement checklist review (Priya) — target completion: 2027-06-28 — owner: Priya Shah
- Legal review & redlines (NovaCorp legal) — target start: 2027-06-29 — owner: Alex Johnson
- Exec decision / PO issuance — target: 2027-07-12 — owner: Alex Johnson
- Pilot kickoff (sandbox + 2-week validation) — target: 2027-07-19 — owner: Marissa Cole / NovaCorp Eng lead

Next steps (actionable)
1) I will send a 1-page exec summary + a mutual action plan (attached) for your CFO / procurement.
2) Priya to share the procurement checklist and SOC2 artifacts — (Priya: please add the DocuSign security contact if needed).
3) Alex to confirm exec sponsor availability for a procurement sync next week.
4) Redwood to scope dedicated capacity pricing vs hosted pricing and return a formal proposal by 2027-06-25.

Attachments: redwood-exec-summary-novacorp.pdf, mutual-action-plan-novacorp.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick follow-up with your procurement/IT team this week.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive\Redwood Inference\mm: +1 (415) 555-0189
https://redwood.ai

---
